goals.description: Comprehensive Audit of File Structure, AI Structure, and Qdrant Utilization
goals.verificationCriteria: Audit document .omg/ultragoal/audit_v3.md exists detailing decoupling status, tool execution gaps, AI JSON resilience, and Qdrant snapshotting opportunities
goals.evidence: Completed comprehensive audit documented in .omg/ultragoal/audit_v3.md verifying zero UI/server leaks, free-tier routing, RLAIF learning, and identifying zero-dependency tool calling, portable memory snapshots, and JSON repair as perfection targets.

goals.description: Zero-Dependency Free Tool & Function Calling Framework (src/swarm/tools/)
goals.verificationCriteria: ToolRegistry and SwarmTool interfaces implemented with built-in free analysis tools; agents can register and execute deterministic tools during analysis without external dependencies
goals.evidence: Created SwarmTool, ToolRegistry, and 4 standard free analysis tools (calculator, stats_summary, regex_match, json_extract) in src/swarm/tools/; integrated tool parsing, stripToolCalls, and execution into SwarmEngine; exported via ./tools subpath; verified via Step 22 in test-portable-swarm.ts.

goals.description: Portable Memory Cortex Snapshotting & Cross-App Hydration (exportMemories / importMemories)
goals.verificationCriteria: MemoryCortex supports exportMemories and importMemories in JSON/JSONL format with deduplication and quality preservation across in-memory and Qdrant stores
goals.evidence: Implemented exportMemories, exportJson, exportJsonl, and importMemories in MemoryCortex; supports JSON/JSONL serialization, cross-app targetAppId remapping, deduplication against existing memory points, vector preservation, and Qdrant/in-memory fallback store synchronization; verified via Step 23 in test-portable-swarm.ts.

goals.description: Resilient Zero-Drift AI JSON Repair & Schema Guard (src/swarm/parser.ts)
goals.verificationCriteria: Parser cleanly extracts and repairs malformed JSON, markdown fences, and truncated output from free-tier models without crashing
goals.evidence: Created zero-dependency repairJson, parseJsonSafe, guardAnalystResponse, guardManagerResponse, guardVerificationResult, and repairAndValidate in src/swarm/parser.ts; handles markdown fences, unclosed thinking tags, unquoted keys, Python literals, trailing commas, comments, and truncated JSON; integrated into Agent.run, AnalysisLifecycle, and SwarmEngine; exported via ./parser; verified via Step 24 in test-portable-swarm.ts.

goals.description: End-to-End Test Suite, Typecheck, Build, and Documentation Verification
goals.verificationCriteria: Automated tests in test-portable-swarm.ts verify tools, snapshots, and JSON repair; tsc --noEmit and npm test pass 100%
goals.evidence: Executed full test suite (npm test): test:portable passed all 24 validation steps; test:simulation passed all 7 multi-app phases; test:dist verified compiled ESM/CJS bundles and tools/parser subpaths; test:cli verified doctor/init/run commands; test:server verified HTTP and SSE streaming. Typecheck tsc --noEmit passed cleanly (0 errors); dual build npm run build succeeded.
